feats.title: Brute Force
feats.description: When you hit an enemy with a melee weapon daily attack, you can also push the target 1 square and knock the target prone.

feats.title: Cast Aside
feats.description: Whenever a Medium or smaller creature succeeds in escaping from being grabbed by you, you can slide the creature 3 squares as an opportunity action.

feats.title: Dutiful Servant
feats.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls on attacks granted by your allies' powers.

feats.title: Great Goliath
feats.description: When you use your second wind, you gain +3 to all defenses instead of the normal +2.

feats.title: Markings of the Blessed
feats.description: The first time you make a saving throw during each of your turns, you can roll twice and use either result.

feats.title: Markings of the Victor
feats.description: The first time you make an attack roll during each encounter, you can roll twice and use either result.

feats.title: Stone's Wrath
feats.description: When you take damage from an attack while you are affected by your stone's endurance, your next melee attack before the end of your next turn deals 1d6 extra damage.

feats.title: Kord's Resilience
feats.description: While your stone's endurance racial power is active, allies adjacent to you have the same resistance that the power grants you.
